messages:
Zoe: Midnight poll: whats your absolute go-to late-night snack when the cravings hit? (serious science) :crescent_moon:
Ben: Cold pizza. Always. Even the crust is therapeutic. :pizza:
Riley: Yogurt + honey + granola. Feels fancy but takes 30 seconds.
Kara: Peanut butter straight from the jar. No spoon shame. 
Ollie: Toasted bagel with cream cheese. Ritual.
Zoe: @Ben cold pizza is the classic. @Kara no judgment here. 
SnackBot: Friendly reminder: please label shared food in the fridge. Leftovers unclaimed after 48h will be composted. :seedling:
Riley: Wild card: I sometimes microwave a banana with cinnamon and its actually life-changing.
Ben: Heated banana?? Im intrigued and slightly scared.
Kara: Ive done this. Hot banana + peanut butter = dessert-level.
Ollie: Vote: Cold pizza, Yogurt parfait, Peanut butter spooning, Bagel. Say your pick.
Zoe: Cold pizza
Ben: Cold pizza
Riley: Yogurt parfait
Kara: Peanut butter spooning (best phrase 2026)
Ollie: Bagel
Zoe: Tally: Cold pizza 2, Yogurt 1, PB 1, Bagel 1. Highly conclusive.
Ben: Follow-up challenge: whoever brings their midnight snack to Friday coffee hour gets a sticker.
Riley: I will bring a jar of granola. 
Kara: I will bring a suspiciously large jar of peanut butter.
SnackBot: Event created: "Midnight Snack Show-and-Tell" Friday 10:00 in the kitchen. :tada:
Ollie: If Ben brings cold pizza at 10am I will be impressed and slightly concerned.
Ben: I accept these terms.
Zoe: This thread is both critical and non-essential. See you Friday.
